title: Oxva Slim Stick Classic Tobacco Prefilled Vape Pods
description: These Classic Tobacco Prefilled Pods for the Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit deliver a familiar, robust flavour in a ready-to-use design. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and offers up to 600 puffs with a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung draw. The flavour recreates the earthy, full-bodied taste of traditional Tobacco, making it an approachable choice for vapers who prefer straightforward, tobacco-inspired blends. Each pod contains a built-in coil for consistent flavour and vapour production, while the sealed design ensures quick and mess-free replacements. Supplied in a pack of two, these pods are ideal for Slim Stick users who want a reliable, tobacco-style vape with minimal effort.
